{{Quote|They are a transplanted breed of arachne from Endor. They have a type of poison I think I can synthesize for use by Jabba.|[[Tori Radeen]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BG" />}}
'''Bone gnashers''' were a breed<ref name="JDW" /> of subterranean<ref name="SWG:BG" /> [[arachne]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="JDW" /> Bone gnashers were so called because they were able to rapidly strip the flesh off corpses.<ref name="SWGTCGPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I need you to go into a cave nearby and find creatures called Bone Gnashers. |Tori Radeen, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BG" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a pack of bone gnashers inhabited the [[Krayt Cult Cave]] near [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:BG" /><ref name="JDW" /> They had been transplanted from Endor to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="JDW" /> likely by the [[Krayt Cult]]ists themselves.<ref name="SWGTCGPOGG" />

Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] was sent by [[Tori Radeen]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] bone gnashers in the Krayt Cult Cave, and bring back six [[Poison/Legends|poison]] glands. Tori Radeen used the glands to create a new poison for use by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="SWG:BG" /><ref name="JDW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bone gnashers appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Bone gnashers were added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
